newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea leader says players must develop jump shot.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea leader says players must develop jump shot.

text.p: North Korea's defacto leader Kim Jong-il has taken time out from working on the country's food shortage and economic problems to offer some advice to the nation's basketball team.

He has said that since North Korean's tend to be somewhat short, the country's basketball players must concentrate on shooting from a distance to win international tournaments, Radiopress news agency reported on Tuesday.

Tokyo-based Radiopress, which monitors the reclusive nation's official press, quoted government newspaper Minju Joson as saying Kim had recently lectured the country's basketball elite on developing an effective winning strategy.

"In order to win international basketball tournaments in the near future...we must counteract the natural disadvantage of physique by playing a fast game centred around long shots," Radiopress, which is monitored in Tokyo, quoted Kim as saying.
North Korea's basketball players were training hard with the aim of taking a major world trophy in the near future, Radiopress quoted the newspaper as saying.
